title: reaping twice flags the worker once: the second reap writes and counts nothing new
source: cli/jitso/reap.test.ts: 'reaping twice does not repeat the same rule_break'
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-28). The unlogged worker count of the summary is the number of rule_break lines this reap wrote, so a worker flagged by an earlier reap is not counted again.

stdout.regex: (?m)^jitso reap: 0 launch\(es\) marked ended, 1 unlogged worker\(s\), 0 analyzed$
(?m)^jitso reap: 0 launch\(es\) marked ended, 0 unlogged worker\(s\), 0 analyzed$
